== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]], also known as the Way Between [[Worlds]], is a fundamental cosmic force characterized by absolute order. It acts as a connective vine for [[Iterations]], which are individual worlds or points of light that exist within its structure. [[The Way]] provides the stability necessary for reality, causality, and coherent existence to persist; without its influence, worlds risk succumbing to chaos or being destroyed by the collision of different realities. It is often visualized as a vast, [[sapphire]]-colored network of flowing rivers and branches that transport travelers between different locations and worlds. Individuals with significant potential, known as [[Waybound]], possess the ability to connect with or manipulate this power. The [[Abidan]] are an order that interacts heavily with the Way, utilizing its properties for travel and stabilization. Certain specialized groups, such as the [[Fox Division]], can bind the Way to specific destinations to facilitate movement within and between [[Iterations]]. While the Way can be used for healing, transportation, and reinforcing power, it can also be severed or weakened, leading to instability, the loss of connection to reality, or the emergence of the Void.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[The Way]] is a strange [[sapphire]] world located beyond space that serves as a connection between realms. This connection can be weakened if planets are destroyed, and a world's temporal stability is directly linked to its relationship with it. During an attempt to escape, the [[Sage]] tries to travel through this expanse. While [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] refers to it simply as the Way, [[Lindon]] demonstrates its physical nature by punching his fist into it.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Way]] is a chaotic, rich blue river characterized by shifting currents and flows that can buffet travelers. While the [[Bow of the Silent King]] touches its surface, [[Northstrider]] once emerged from a bright blue twist within the river. Although it can be used as a means of escape, the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s will prevents such travel, and [[Reigan Shen|Reigan]] once attempted to touch it. Within [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], [[Lindon]] granted [[Northstrider]] permission to open the Way, after which [[Yerin]] cut a hole in it. The river can be commanded to restore damage, and [[Lindon]] eventually hoped to achieve a deeper connection to the entity.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Existing outside the world, the Way is a medium involved in the process of creation that contains various branches and can be entered through portals. The [[Fox Division]] is able to bind this space to specific destinations, though a world's human population serves as the tie to it. While the [[Abidan]] hold special [[Authority|authority]] over this realm, [[Lindon]] does not draw power from it, even though it can manifest as a symbol complex within his [[spirit]]. Accessing this medium requires learning to sense oneself, a connection that [[Cirian]] was unable to muster.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]] is a medium or space that can be bound to destinations by the [[Fox Division]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]] exists outside the world.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A world's human population ties them to [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Lindon]] does not draw on [[Way|the Way]] for power.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]] can manifest as a symbol complex in [[Lindon]]'s [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Abidan]] have special [[Authority|authority]] over Way{{!}}the Way.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Cirian]] could not muster his connection to [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sensing [[Way|the Way]] begins with learning to sense oneself.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]] is a location that can be entered via portals and contains branches.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]] is involved in the process of creation.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}</li>
